name: PDF Upload & Legal Document Text Extraction

drag_and_drop_pdf_upload.details: Interactive drag-and-drop zone with drag-over visual feedback and fallback file picker

pypdf_text_extraction.details: Multi-page text extraction preserving paragraph and page structure using pypdf 6.18.1

file_metadata_and_badge_display.details: Displays filename, formatted size, page count, word count, character count, and status badges

extracted_text_preview_and_editing.details: Extracted text populates judgment review textarea with an informative review banner

frozen_m4_inference.details: Section-Aware TF-IDF inference operates on extracted PDF text via existing POST /api/judipl/analyze

frozen_m8_inference.details: Hybrid Late Fusion Ensemble inference operates on extracted PDF text with genuine probabilities

scanned_pdf_detection.details: Image-only PDFs are honestly flagged with 'This PDF appears to be scanned. OCR extraction is currently unavailable.'

security_and_size_enforcement.details: 15 MB payload limit (413), 100-page limit (400), %PDF- signature check (400), automatic temp file cleanup

temporary_file_cleanup.details: Guaranteed cleanup in finally: block with 0 orphaned temp files

corpus_task_isolation.details: PDF extraction is strictly scoped to Jud-IPL; IL-TUR displays explicit corpus isolation banner

pdf_ocr_extraction.details: OCR pipeline is not included; scanned documents are detected honestly without fabricating text
